base:_SHADOW_CACHE.note: memo for draw_shadow, which nothing calls

base:_minion_cache_key.note: ten-part key; pose part matches minion_anim.pose_key

base:apply_hurt_flash.note: no runtime caller, but the atlas bake delegates the +90 flash to Godot

base:cached_minion_draw.note: body render + red-team recolour + crop; overlays are split out natively

base:calculate_animation_offsets.note: returned bob/sway but no renderer calls it; baked frames carry the bob

base:draw_hp_bar.note: drawn live after the sprite blit; exact rects and colours

base:draw_shadow.note: each namespace has its own _draw_ground_shadow; this one is never called

base:draw_slash_effects.note: arbitrary angles, not only the 32 baked steps

base:draw_slow_effect.note: circle + three orbiting sparks; source freezes one frame
